skill.description: Review instructions. Defaults to the skill bundled with the package. Part of the version hash.

guidelines.description: Project documents the reviewer compares the change against: always, or only when a condition applies.

anyOf.description: A document the reviewer always reads, relative to the repository root.

path.description: Document path, relative to the repository root. Must exist.

when.description: When the reviewer should read it, stated in terms of the change, e.g. "an import crosses a src/features/* boundary". One sentence.

covers.description: The rules this document holds, so a finding can cite it as its rule.

instructions.description: Project text added to what the coding agent and the reviewer are told.

session.description: Project rules for the coding agent, added to the SessionStart context.

review.description: Extra instructions for the reviewer, session or CLI. Part of the version hash.

afterReview.description: What the coding agent does after the review is recorded, e.g. update a document.

gates.description: Steps that must pass before work starts, like checks before a review.

begin.description: Shell commands that must pass before begin records a baseline. They get RATED_REVIEW_LOOP_INPUT (from begin --input), RATED_REVIEW_LOOP_TASK and RATED_REVIEW_LOOP_SESSION_KEY.

checks.description: Shell commands that must all pass before a review is requested.

checkTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of each check and gate, in milliseconds.

include.description: Globs, relative to the repository root, of files that can be reviewed.

exclude.description: Globs excluded from review. Replaces the default list.

reviewer.description: session: the agent that wrote the code reviews it. <client>-cli: a separate CLI process does.

language.description: Language the reviewer writes findings in, e.g. "en" or "ko".

localDir.description: Local run state. Must be ignored by git.
